title: Albums and binder pages
summary: Cards in TCG Card Shop Simulator do not have to sit on a shelf: the game has an album with binder pages, page visibility and a mode you enter and leave to look at them.
body: The album is a place cards can be kept and viewed rather than only stock, which is why the game has a mode for looking through it.
Binder pages have an index for the cards they hold, so a card's position in the album is tracked rather than incidental.
Page visibility is handled by the game, which is how the album can show some pages and hide others while you work through it.
What this entry does not tell you: how many pages an album has, whether stored cards keep their value, or how customers react. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Cards can be kept in an album with binder pages.
A binder page tracks the index of the card it holds.
Page visibility is controlled by the game.
Looking through the album is a mode you enter and leave.
The binder has its own open and close objects, with a left and a right page kept apart.
facts.evidence: asset names: BinderOpen, BinderClose, BinderPageL, BinderPageR

facts.claim: The build ships more than one binder page picture, including a nine-pocket page.
It ships more than one binder book as well, including an all-star book.
The game ships a further album picture, in an eight-up layout.
The game draws a collection icon of its own for a collection.
The game ships a binder book of its own, printed with its brand.
An all-star binder cover is shipped as its own picture, carrying the card game's logo and a collector section.
The binder book has a material and animation controllers of its own.
The pages have an animation controller of their own as well, a thickness, and idle states for the next and previous pages while they are hidden.
facts.evidence: asset names: BinderPage_AnimCtrl, BinderPageThickness, BinderPage_HiddenNext_Idle, BinderPage_HiddenPrevious_Idle

facts.claim: Turning a binder page has reveal animations in both directions, with a revealed idle state of its own.
The binder book is carried in more than one finish: a second book, a premium one and a transparent one beside the ordinary book.
The optimized binder carries an albedo sheet and a second sheet of its own.
The album has sounds of its own for opening it, flipping a page and the cards appearing.
